about.title: About Korea Car Parts Direct
about.subtitle: The reliable bridge connecting Korean automotive quality with drivers and workshops in Azerbaijan.
about.story1: Founded to solve the issue of counterfeit and overpriced Korean auto parts in Azerbaijan, we established direct logistics channels between Seoul, Incheon and Baku.
about.story2: Every single part in our inventory is sourced directly from Hyundai Mobis, Kia Genuine, and Tier-1 Korean OEM manufacturers (Mando, Valeo Korea, Sangsin, CTR, Iljin).
about.feature1Desc: Original hologram-sealed packaging directly from South Korea.
about.feature2Desc: Weekly direct cargo flights from Incheon International Airport to Heydar Aliyev International Airport.
about.feature3Desc: We supply individual car owners, repair shops, and commercial auto fleets across Azerbaijan.
